newsitem.title: CHILE: Argentina's Maradona in hospital after TV show.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Maradona in hospital after TV show.

text.p: Argentine soccer star Diego Maradona was taken to a hospital on Monday after falling ill while appearing as a guest on a Chilean television programme, officials from the television channel said.

Maradona, who was due to take part in the second part of the talk show, left the stage during an interval after complaining of blood pressure problems, the hosts of the programme Viva El Lunes on channel Canal 13 said.

Spectators said the player began to look uncomfortable, constantly crossed and uncrossed his arms, and then began to sweat heavily. He asked the host to be allowed to leave but was told to sit until a break in the programme, when he left.
Television officials said Maradona was taken to a private hospital for medical checks.
Maradona arrived in Santiago on Monday to take part in the show and to discuss a possible transfer deal to a Chilean football club from Argentine club Boca Juniors.
Chilean media have said Maradona may be in talks with the club Deportes Temuco.
